title: Art City (Cincinnati Art Week edition Japanese-style rice lager)
location_text: Esoteric Brewing Co., 918 E McMillan St
description: Meet ART CITY 🌀🍺. A special Cincinnati Art Week edition of @esotericbeer Japanese-style Rice Lager, featuring artwork by @baileyelderberry. Clean, crisp, and made for gallery hopping. Want to carry Art City? Hit us up.
notes: Cincinnati Magazine: "This Japanese-Style Rice Lager was made in collaboration with CAW for an evening of gallery-hopping." Can label art is by @baileyelderberry.
